turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My son wants a drum kit for his birthday. Please talk me out of it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: I might talk you into an electronic kit instead. With headphones, you'd barely hear a thing.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait, really? How quiet are they?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Much quieter than real drums. You'll hear a soft tapping, but nothing like the full noise.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Beginner kits are often cheaper than acoustic ones. And they take up less room too.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: sort of convinced me. Should he take lessons?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: A few lessons early on are really worth it. Good habits from the start make practice much more fun.
